crossRefs.note: For a child is born to us. A son is given to us; and the government will be on his shoulders. His name will be called…
Of the increase of his government and of peace there shall be no end, on David’s throne, and on his kingdom, to…
“In those days and at that time, I will cause a Branch of righteousness to grow up to David. He will execute justice…
then I will also cast away the offspring of Jacob, and of David my servant, so that I will not take of his offspring to…
I will set up one shepherd over them, and he will feed them, even my servant David. He will feed them, and he will be…
I, Yahweh, will be their God, and my servant David prince among them. I, Yahweh, have spoken it.
“ ‘ “My servant David will be king over them. They all will have one shepherd. They will also walk in my ordinances…
They will dwell in the land that I have given to Jacob my servant, in which your fathers lived. They will dwell…
Afterward the children of Israel shall return, and seek Yahweh their God, and David their king, and shall come with…
In that day I will raise up the tent of David who is fallen, and close up its breaches, and I will raise up its ruins…
that they may possess the remnant of Edom, and all the nations who are called by my name,” says Yahweh who does this.
Behold, you will conceive in your womb and give birth to a son, and shall name him ‘Jesus.’
Praise Yah! Praise Yahweh from the heavens! Praise him in the heights!
“Glory to God in the highest, on earth peace, good will toward men.”
saying, “Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord! Peace in heaven, and glory in the highest!”

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: Blessed is the kingdom of our father David that is coming in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!”
translations.bsb: “Blessed is the coming kingdom of our father David!” “Hosanna in the highest!”
translations.kjv: Blessed be the kingdom of our father David, that cometh in the name of the Lord: Hosanna in the highest.
translations.asv: Blessed is the kingdom that cometh, the kingdom of our father David: Hosanna in the highest.
